independence.statement: I reviewed the frozen reference and candidate independently.

blockingFindings: Foundation contract labels and values diverge: H1/H2/Small rows change to Display/Title, the 64 spacing sample changes to 48, and the 4px radius sample changes to Pill.
The work-order owner control loses the reference selector disclosure affordance and reads as a plain text input.
rationale: The candidate preserves the shell, major sections, CTA and 42/08/02 statistics, metric cards, filter/table workflow, and 240/64/1440-gutter-24 shell values; interaction evidence also confirms the work-order filter task. However, it changes substantive foundation specifications and the owner-control semantics, which can mislead users of this design-system contract. Broad layout, typography, icon, and component-geometry displacement also prevents pixel-fidelity acceptance.
